question: Across every calendar date in 2025, including dates with zero Delivered orders, what was the average number of Delivered orders for each weekday? Which weekday had the highest average?

action.query:
WITH daily_delivered AS (
  SELECT d.DATE_DAY, f.DAY_NAME, COUNT(o.ORDER_ID) AS DELIVERED_ORDERS
  FROM ZOMATO_DLR.INTERMEDIATE.INT_DATE_FEATURES d
  JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.DIM_DATE f ON f.DATE_DAY = d.DATE_DAY
  LEFT JOIN ZOMATO_DLR.CORE.FACT_ORDER o
    ON o.ORDER_DATE = d.DATE_DAY
   AND o.IS_DELIVERED = TRUE
  WHERE d.DATE_DAY >= '2025-01-01' AND d.DATE_DAY < '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY d.DATE_DAY, f.DAY_NAME
)
SELECT DAY_NAME, AVG(DELIVERED_ORDERS) AS AVG_DELIVERED_ORDERS_PER_CALENDAR_DATE
FROM daily_delivered
GROUP BY DAY_NAME
ORDER BY CASE DAY_NAME
  WHEN 'Monday' THEN 1 WHEN 'Tuesday' THEN 2 WHEN 'Wednesday' THEN 3
  WHEN 'Thursday' THEN 4 WHEN 'Friday' THEN 5 WHEN 'Saturday' THEN 6
  WHEN 'Sunday' THEN 7 END

action.answer: Average Delivered orders per calendar date in 2025, grouped by weekday (including dates with zero Delivered orders): Monday 9,094.365385 orders/date; Tuesday 9,082.788462; Wednesday 9,053.773585; Thursday 9,473.653846; Friday 12,228.980769; Saturday 14,486.211538; Sunday 13,119.134615. Saturday had the highest average, at 14,486.211538 Delivered orders per calendar date.
